setting.help: An NPS detractor (score ≤ 6) or a dissatisfied rating creates an activity assigned to the account owner.
Copy each rating (projects, tickets…) into the unified feedback register.

Minimum number of days between two feedback requests to the same contact, all channels (waves, post-meeting, post-loss, project and ticket ratings). 0 = no guard. Adjustable per program for a slower relationship cadence (90 days recommended).
Deadline of the activity created for a detractor or a dissatisfied rating (practice: 24-72 h).

A notice to the owner for each answer filed in the register, promoters included. Off, only detractors are flagged through the reminder activity, and an enthusiastic answer goes unnoticed. The notice follows the recipient's Odoo preference (email or inbox).
Create an activity (5-day deadline) when a respondent agrees to be quoted.
Rolling window of the score shown (dashboard, digest, programs). The score is hidden below 10 answers - under that, the margin of error exceeds ±20 points.

Recipient of a wave's "Send a test" button. The test is sent for real, with a real answer link: use an address of your own. It counts in no statistic and does not feed the register, so it tests neither the write to the register nor the detractor loop.
Number of days to acknowledge a complaint. Used to compute the deadline shown on each complaint.
